title: Low-Rank Optimal Transport through Factor Relaxation with Latent Coupling
tldr_zh: LC 因子化解耦低秩 OT 为三个子 OT，坐标镜像下降统一 W/GW/FGW 与均衡/非均衡/半松弛
tldr_en: Latent coupling factorization decouples low-rank OT into three sub-OT problems solved by coordinate mirror descent

key_numbers.number: FRLC runtime = half of LOT runtime (CPU), n=m=1000, rank r=100
FRLC-SR Spearman ρ = 0.467 (W), 0.275 (GW), 0.465 (FGW) on ST alignment
LOT-U GW Spearman ρ = 0.005, ARI = 0.0, AMI = 0.0
FRLC beats GWL and SpecGWL on 9/12 and 11/12 graph datasets
E11.5 slice ≈ 30,000 cells, E12.5 slice ≈ 50,000 cells
